name: Takko (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Takko town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing a cross within a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Takko, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 4 April 1935.

features.role: Takko town emblem — a broken ring enclosing a cross within a ring
